Subject: Post-call recap: PayVault security priorities, evidence asks & next steps

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, your priorities, and proposed next steps so we have aligned owners/timeline.

What you told us (pain points)
- SOC 2: need confirmation Redwood can provide a redacted Type II report and an artifact bundle for procurement review.
- Audit logs: must be able to provide per-customer access to audit logs (immutable, tamper-evident) and a clear retention policy.
- Data retention / DPA: specific retention window and deletion processes required for regulated customers.
- Pen test evidence: summary report plus remediation timeline for critical findings.

Goals
- Procurement sign-off by mid-Mar so PayVault can begin pilot in early Apr.
- Clear evidence that Redwood meets baseline SOC 2 controls and log retention requirements.

Proposed next steps (owners & target dates)
1) Redwood to provide: redacted SOC 2 Type II report + one-page summary of scope (Mar 2) — owner: Marissa Cole.
2) Redwood to confirm audit-log schema, retention defaults and options for 1y retention (Mar 1) — owner: Aditya Rao.
3) PayVault to send completed security questionnaire and any procurement-specific clauses for DPA redlines (Feb 19) — owner: Elena / Tom.
4) If needed, schedule a short follow-up with Legal + Security (30m window) to walk the DPA and pen-test evidence (week of Feb 23).

Attachments: we flagged that you had a questionnaire to share — referenced below.

Would you like Marissa or I to join the follow-up with procurement/legal? We can keep it tight and focused on the evidence you need to close the purchase order.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side and I've attached our questionnaire (payvault_security_questionnaire.xlsx).

Questions:
- Retention: is the 90-day default for raw audit logs configurable? We may need 1 year for certain merchants. If configurable, is this an extra cost or part of the dedicated plan?
- Per-customer audit logs: do you provide a way for us to export logs for a single tenant (audit export) or do you only provide aggregated/system-level logs?
- SOC 2: we need a Type II dated within the last 12 months and a short cover letter indicating controls in-scope (multi-tenant segregation, key management, incident response). A fully redacted copy is fine for procurement.
- Pen test: can you provide a pen test executive summary and whether you complete annual third-party tests? Any outstanding criticals we should be aware of?

We'll fill out the questionnaire and return it by EOD tomorrow. We'll also invite our procurement lead if we get to DPA redlines.

Thanks,

elena@payvault.com

Hi Elena / Tom — Marissa from Redwood Security here; thanks for the questionnaire, we looked it over quickly and wanted to provide high-level answers up front and the artifacts we can share.

Short answers:
- Retention: Default raw audit-log retention is 90 days. We offer configurable retention buckets (90d, 1y, 3y) as part of our Dedicated plans or as an add-on for Hosted customers. Pricing depends on retention bucket and required immutability guarantees — Aditya will follow up with specifics and a price estimate.
- Per-customer logs: Yes — we support tenant-scoped audit exports. Exports are delivered as gzipped JSON/CSV bundles containing the audit events for a single tenant for the requested window. We can automate exports via the API or provide SFTP delivery for procurement.
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report completed 2025-11-12. We can produce a redacted PDF for procurement; we will include a one-page cover letter highlighting scope (storage, serving runtime, key management, incident response).
- Pen test: We complete annual third-party penetration tests; the last report had two medium findings (remediated), no open criticals. We can provide an executive summary and a remediation timeline.

Artifacts we can share (initial bundle):
- redwood_soc2_2025_typeii-redacted.pdf (redacted copy)
- audit_log_schema.csv (sample export schema and field descriptions)
- pen_test_execsummary_2025.pdf (executive summary, no raw findings)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Jordan will upload our redacted SOC 2 + exec summaries to a shared drive and post the hubspot deal record (today).
2) Aditya will send a retention pricing matrix and API examples for tenant-scoped export (by EOD Mon, Mar 1).
3) If PayVault wants DPA redline work, let's plan a 30m call with both Legal teams week of Feb 23 — please suggest windows.

We can crop any artifact further if your procurement team needs extra redaction. Happy to jump on the procurement call if helpful.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: redwood_soc2_2025_typeii-redacted.pdf, audit_log_schema.csv, pen_test_execsummary_2025.pdf
